## The nightly bump never declares a wake routine, and wrapped owner entries keep their full text

### The package-update routine never writes `autonomy.cockpitWake: "routine"` (#100)

The 0.39.0 notes ask adopting projects to set `autonomy.cockpitWake`, and the nightly package-update routine applies
every step release notes ask for. In a project whose wake task was deleted, the bump could declare `"routine"` for a
routine that does not exist.

- **`routines/package-updates.md`:** the routine never writes `"routine"`; only the setup brief in
  `routines/cockpit-wake.md` does, after its test issue was claimed. A key that is set stays as it is. When the key
  is missing, the bump writes `"none"` and records the owner step "set up the cockpit wake routine
  (routines/cockpit-wake.md → Setting it up)" (under `## Owner decisions and checks`, or as an `ownerSteps` entry
  without a live roadmap). An `autonomy` key that WORKFLOW §2 no longer lists is removed in the same bump.
- **Release gate:** `validate.mjs` fails when the routine drops either rule.

### `owner_queue` entries keep the text of a wrapped checkbox (#90)

`context_state.py` read only the first line of a roadmap checkbox, so an item wrapped at a fixed width ended
mid-sentence in `owner_queue[].text`, and a cockpit issue quoted the cut text.

- **`open_checkboxes()`** joins an unticked checkbox with its indented continuation lines, up to the next list item,
  heading or blank line, whitespace collapsed. This covers `## Owner decisions and checks` and
  `## Before the next release`, and the doctor checks that read them.
- **Ids:** an entry that never wrapped keeps its `id`. A wrapped entry changes its `text` once; it keeps its `id`
  when the regeneration matches it to the cut text (the same item, or text close enough). An unmatched one gets a
  new `id`, so an aggregator may show it once as new.

Adopting projects: after the bump run `npx softure-skills state` and commit `context/state.json`.

Install from npm: `npm i -D @softure-ai/skills@0.39.1`

Install from this release (no registry, no auth): `npm i -D https://github.com/SOFTURE/SKILLS/releases/download/v0.39.1/softure-ai-skills-0.39.1.tgz`

GitHub Packages: `@softure/skills@0.39.1` (requires a token with read:packages)
